objective_strength.title: Clinician-led Social proof is current, treatment-specific and decision-useful.

binding_constraint.title: Local Search cannot reliably surface the treatment proof already present elsewhere.
binding_constraint.statement: Local Search cannot reliably surface the treatment proof already present on Social. Geo-grid visibility and incomplete GBP treatment categories keep high-intent patients from encountering the practice beyond its immediate address.

do_not_do.title: Do not increase paid traffic until local treatment discovery and proof continuity are corrected.
do_not_do.rationale: Paid ads and extra traffic would send more people into a market where the practice is not discoverable for priority treatments, amplifying the same search-visibility leak.
revisit_after: Priority-treatment geo-grid cells recover to a useful local result set
GBP categories and services match the approved treatment catalogue

recommendations.title: Pilot the clearer market-practice pattern before replacing tools or clinical inputs
recommendations.current_state: The fictional subject separates treatment explanation, proof, price conditions and booking.
recommendations.market_shift: Fictional local and category references present those elements as one continuous patient decision path.
recommendations.evidence_scope: Synthetic local competitors plus a fictional category/positioning reference; public adoption signal only.
recommendations.business_implication: A clearer path may reduce decision friction and should be tested before additional reach is funded.
recommendations.transition_economics: Use a bounded page/process pilot and measure completion; do not commit to equipment, software or clinical replacement from this evidence.
dependencies: Qualified clinical review for any treatment, drug, device or protocol implication

recommendations.limitations: Synthetic illustration. Adoption does not prove superiority, safety, profitability or patient fit.

gap_inventory.title: Geo-grid visibility collapses outside the immediate address area.
gap_inventory.why_it_matters: Priority-treatment local discovery is materially weaker than the synthetic peer set.

repair_plan.outcome: Priority-treatment visibility is measured from a reproducible geo-grid and the weakest cells have an evidence-backed correction plan.
diy_steps: Freeze the priority treatment, city query, grid centre, five-mile radius and named comparison set.
Export the 5×5 baseline and label the cells where the practice falls outside the useful local result set.
Check each weak cell against GBP category, treatment and entity evidence before documenting the corrective action.
Repeat the same grid after the accepted changes and compare like-for-like evidence.
repair_plan.owner_role: Local search specialist, with an owner approving the priority treatment and market
done_when: Dated 5×5 export with query, centre, radius and competitors

gap_inventory.title: GBP categories and treatment inventory are incomplete.
gap_inventory.why_it_matters: The profile gives search platforms and patients an incomplete view of the priority offer.

repair_plan.outcome: The public GBP categories and services accurately represent the approved priority treatments without stuffing or unsupported claims.
diy_steps: Export the current primary category, secondary categories and service inventory.
Compare that inventory with the approved treatment catalogue and the named local comparison set.
Draft the smallest accurate category and service changes, including owner review for naming and compliance.
Publish accepted changes and capture the live profile state.
repair_plan.owner_role: GBP/local search specialist with owner approval

implementation_paths.diy: Assign the listed owner roles internally, follow task sequence 1–3 and retain every acceptance artifact in one shared evidence folder.
implementation_paths.other_provider: Give another local-search and web team this report, the metric evidence and task IDs; require them to return the same acceptance evidence without re-hiding the method.
implementation_paths.defer: Preserve the dated baseline, monitor the two lower-priority items and repeat the same collection method before making a later decision.
implementation_paths.caesthetic: Ask CAESTHETIC to scope only the selected tasks, access, owners and acceptance checks in a separate written Sprint agreement.

why_caesthetic.evidence_advantage: CAESTHETIC has already assembled the synthetic case method, evidence references and dependency order, so a real-case team would not need to restart diagnosis.
why_caesthetic.coordination_advantage: The work crosses local search, content, web implementation and compliance acceptance; one coordinator can reduce handoff cost while keeping specialist accountability visible.
why_caesthetic.sprint_boundary: The Growth Score is not purchased Sprint scope. A 30-Day Sprint includes only tasks, dependencies and acceptance evidence confirmed later in writing, with no ranking, enquiry or revenue guarantee.
why_caesthetic.ownership: The owner keeps the report, evidence pack and complete task plan and may implement it in-house, use another provider, defer it or stop. There is no lock-in.
